visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Classroom setting. A female student with brown hair in a white school shirt and plaid bow tie sits at a wooden desk. She puts down her pen, looks satisfied, and places her head on her arms to sleep. Other students are visible in the background, out of focus. (2) A solid purple background appears with the text '30分鐘後' displayed in the center. (3) Back to the classroom. A male student next to her finishes his paper. The female student wakes up, looks at his paper, then flips hers over, revealing a full page of unanswered questions. Her eyes widen in shock. (4) She begins writing with extreme speed, her hand a blur. The teacher, a woman with orange-dyed hair, stands up and begins collecting papers. The student continues to write frantically as the teacher approaches. (5) The teacher reaches the student's desk and tries to grab the paper. The student clings to it, moving it away while still trying to write. They struggle over the paper. (6) A series of fast-cut scenes show the teacher chasing the student through a hallway and into a bathroom. The student is crouched, still writing on the paper while the teacher tries to pull it away. (7) Final scene in a bathroom stall. The teacher looks exhausted, holding her stomach, while the student finally hands over the completed paper with a relieved expression.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main student, 1 female teacher, 1 male student nearby, and 3 background students.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main student has brown hair and wears a white short-sleeved school uniform with a red/white plaid bow. The teacher has bright orange-dyed hair and wears a white t-shirt and light green trousers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A typical bright classroom with wooden desks, a green chalkboard, and school posters. Later, a white-tiled public bathroom with stalls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Video opens with a calm piano melody. A female student's voice is heard saying 'Completed, I can sleep now' in a relaxed, low-arousal tone. (2) A loud 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the phase change. (3) A male student says 'Done' with a short, neutral pitch. Suddenly, a high-pitched gasp SFX and a frantic female voice 'There's a back side?' trigger an immediate shift to high-tempo orchestral music with heavy percussion. (4) Sounds of a pencil scratching paper at high speed overlap with the teacher's authoritative voice announcing time is up. (5) Loud thuds, rustling of clothing, and paper tearing sounds signify a physical struggle. The teacher and student start shouting in high-arousal, strained voices: 'Wait!', 'It's time!', 'Teacher, wait!'. (6) A montage of hard cuts follows, with the music swelling in intensity. Fast vocal exchanges and grunts of exertion are heard as they move through different spaces. (7) The music ends with a comedic stinger. The student says 'Done' with a breathy, relieved tone, followed by the teacher's exhausted, low-pitched complaints about her stomach, concluding with a polite 'Thank you teacher' from the student.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous and highly relatable comedic sketch about the universal student nightmare of realizing an exam has more questions on the back side just as time runs out. It uses exaggerated physical comedy and fast-paced editing to amplify the panic of the situation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video's impact relies on the rapid shift in emotional arousal, moving from extreme relaxation (sleeping) to extreme panic (frantic writing). The audio design, particularly the transition to intense BGM, is crucial for driving the comedic timing.
